sections.heading: Weekly Update
sections.body:
What an uplifting and special week it has been at YTVA!

Rosh Hashanah was truly incredible. The Tefillot were nothing short of inspiring, and the meals, singing, and overall atmosphere were extraordinary. During the day, YTVA joined together with MTVA for Tefillot at a beautiful venue.

Even with Monday being Tzom Gedaliah, both Monday and Tuesday were strong days of learning.

Wishing you and your families a Shabbat Shalom. G'mar Chatimah Tovah!

sections.heading: Dvar Torah
sections.byline: Student Name; Hometown, ST; Shana Bet/Hesder
sections.body:
In preparation for Yom Kippur we talk about kapara all the time which is also the name of the day "Yom Hakippurim". But it seems like the focus is really on Tahara.

The pasuk says "לפני ה׳ תטהרו" so the big question is what is the difference between Kapara and Tahara?
